note: Phase 1 completion matrix. Extends (never replaces) docs/REQUIREMENTS_MATRIX.json and docs/CORPUS_TARGETS.json; counts are recomputed from files by scripts/test-doc-drift.mjs. Status vocabulary: PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED | NOT_IMPLEMENTED | NOT_ASSESSED | NOT_APPLICABLE | BLOCKED_OWNER_DECISION | BLOCKED_PRODUCTION_LOCK.
